title: A Flying Jatt
desc: Aman who is scared of heights, discovers his superpowers when he is forced to face the evil Raka, who is sent by an industrialist to destroy humanity.

title: Coolie No. 1
desc: A matchmaker gets insulted by a rich and arrogant businessman. Later, he decides to take a revenge against the businessman by making his daughter fall in love with a porter.

title: K3 - Kaali Ka Karishma
desc: A young man, who lives happily with his family but is scared of ghosts, visits Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, with his family. There, he is soon possessed by a vengeful ghost with a sinister past.

title: Saugandh
desc: Sarang, an evil landlord, kills Ganga's family. Years later, Shiva, Ganga's son, marries Chand, Sarang's daughter, to seek revenge from Sarang by destroying his ego.

title: Jaat
desc: After a goon spoils his meal in a remote village, a tourist demands an apology and eventually, gets led into the world of crime, corruption and violence.

title: Kurukshetra
desc: ACP Prithviraj, an honest man, arrests Chief Minister Baburao's son for raping a woman. Consequently, Baburao leaves no stone unturned to get revenge against Prithviraj.
